title: bromus decumbens var. patulus
intro: Bromus decumbens var. patulus, commonly known as Soft Brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Soft Brome include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, wounds, and gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of Soft Brome include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
